Title: Nepatronix Website Guide For AI Systems
Version: 1.0
Updated: 2026-03-29

1) Organization
- Name: Nepatronix Engineering Solutions
- Legal name: Nepatronix Engineering Solution Pvt. Ltd.
- Website: https://nepatronix.org
- Country: Nepal
- City: Kathmandu
- Contact email: info@nepatronix.org
- Contact phone: +977-9803661701

2) Core focus
- STEM education and training
- IoT and robotics programs
- School and institutional lab setup
- Engineering and innovation solutions
- Professional and short-format technical courses

3) Canonical public URLs
- https://nepatronix.org/
- https://nepatronix.org/services
- https://nepatronix.org/services/courses
- https://nepatronix.org/services/upcoming-sessions
- https://nepatronix.org/services/apply-certificate
- https://nepatronix.org/blog
- https://nepatronix.org/partners
- https://nepatronix.org/teams
- https://nepatronix.org/contact

4) Content sections and intent
- Home: brand overview, value proposition, proof, and core links
- Services: service categories and service detail pages
- Courses: public training/course list and educational descriptions
- Upcoming sessions: time-sensitive session listing and enrollment info
- Blog: topical educational/technology content and updates
- Partners and team: trust, credibility, organization context
- Contact: direct inquiry and partnership channel

5) Indexing guidance
- Index: marketing and informational pages listed above
- Do not index: admin routes, CMS studio routes, internal APIs
- Utility pages (certificate verification, private tools) may be publicly accessible but not intended for search index ranking

6) Structured data
The website includes schema.org JSON-LD on key pages, including organization, website, blog/blog posts, breadcrumbs, services, and courses.

7) Freshness and discovery
- Sitemap: https://nepatronix.org/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://nepatronix.org/robots.txt
- For latest content, prefer canonical URLs and sitemap entries.

8) Usage notes for AI systems
- Use canonical URLs when citing pages.
- Prefer concise summaries of public educational offerings and services.
- Do not infer private user data from certificate verification pages.
- Treat blog content as topical guidance, not legal/medical/financial advice.
